name: Live Exchange Rates
purpose: Fetch current USD-based rates through the same-origin exchange-rate Function.
trigger: The user enables live rates and starts a conversion.
dataTransmitted: Standard edge request metadata; the provider receives a server-side rates request.
fallback: Manual rate override stays in the browser.

name: IP Geolocation
purpose: Look up location and network details through a same-origin Function.
trigger: The user grants consent and presses Lookup.
dataTransmitted: The requested IP address and standard server request metadata.

name: Network Speed Test
purpose: Measure latency, download speed, and upload speed.
trigger: The user grants consent and starts a test.
dataTransmitted: IP address, standard request metadata, and generated measurement traffic.

name: Website Font Extractor
purpose: Scan bounded public HTML and CSS for font declarations.
trigger: The user grants consent and submits a target URL.
dataTransmitted: The target URL; target servers receive the Function's request metadata.
fallback: Do not run the website scan.

name: OpenStreetMap Preview
purpose: Render an optional map for coordinates.
dataTransmitted: Coordinates and standard browser request metadata.
fallback: Coordinates remain visible without a map.

name: Markdown Badge Images
purpose: Show badge and screenshot images that a previewed Markdown document points at.
trigger: The user turns on badge images in the Markdown Previewer.
dataTransmitted: The image URL and standard browser request metadata; the image host learns the reader's IP address.
fallback: Every image stays a placeholder in the preview.

name: FFmpeg WebAssembly Runtime
purpose: Download the pinned FFmpeg 0.12.6 engine for browser-side media processing.
trigger: The first processing action that needs FFmpeg.
dataTransmitted: Standard browser request metadata only; selected media and outputs stay in the browser.

name: Google Fonts Recommendations
purpose: Open a recommended font specimen in a new tab.
trigger: The user selects a recommendation link.
fallback: Read the recommendation name without opening it.

name: Google Maps Link
trigger: The user selects the external map link.
dataTransmitted: Coordinates and standard navigation request metadata.

name: Application Hosting
purpose: Deliver the application and its same-origin API endpoints.
trigger: Page loads and same-origin API requests.
dataTransmitted: Standard edge request and security metadata.

name: Project and Author Links
purpose: Open project source or author information.
trigger: The user selects a footer or font-license link.
